settings.text: From a small London workshop to 4,000+ bikes in 36 countries

Bamboo Bicycle Club was founded in 2012 by James Marr and Ian McMillan. James had developed bamboo bicycle-building skills in Canada and wanted to share this knowledge with others in London.

What started as a small workshop has grown into something we never expected — a global community of over 4,000 builders across 36+ countries, from Japan to South Africa, Romania to Australia.

But we've always been about more than just bikes. We believe in the power of making things with your hands. Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced builder, there's something transformative about creating your own bicycle from bamboo.

We believe everyone should have the opportunity to build something meaningful with their hands.

Through our workshops, kits, and educational programmes, we're making sustainable manufacturing accessible to all — from corporate teams seeking unique experiences to prisoners rebuilding their lives to school children discovering the joy of making.
